title.en: To be on the verge of / To almost (happen)

sentences.target: '-(으)ㄹ락 말락 하다'는 어떤 사건이 일어날 듯 말 듯한 아슬아슬한 상황을 표현한다.
sentences.en: This form describes a situation in which an event is on the verge of happening but ultimately does not occur.

sentences.target: 실제로 일어나지 않았거나, 일어나는 순간에 가까웠음을 강조한다.
sentences.en: It emphasizes that the event nearly happened or reached the point of occurrence.

sentences.target: 물리적 상황뿐 아니라 감정·결정·변화 등 추상적 상황에도 사용된다.
sentences.en: It applies not only to physical situations but also to emotions, decisions, or abstract changes.

sentences.target: 두 가능성이 공존하나, 실제로는 '거의 일어날 뻔함'에 무게가 실린다.
sentences.en: Two possibilities coexist, but the nuance leans toward ‘it almost happened.’

sentences.target: 문어·구어 모두 사용되지만, 분석적·서술적 글에서 더 자연스럽다.
sentences.en: It appears in both spoken and written language, but is more natural in analytical or descriptive writing.

sentences.target: 위험·실수·손실 등 부정적 맥락에서 자주 등장한다.
sentences.en: It is frequently used in contexts involving risk, errors, or potential losses.

sentences.target: 사건의 경계선에서 일어난 긴장감이나 불확실성을 효과적으로 드러낸다.
sentences.en: It effectively conveys tension or uncertainty at the boundary of an event.

sentences.target: 시간적 여유가 거의 없는 급박한 상황을 서술할 때 적합하다.
sentences.en: It is suitable for describing urgent situations with almost no time margin.

sentences.target: 결과가 성립되기 직전의 미세한 차이를 강조하는 표현이다.
sentences.en: It highlights the fine margin before a result could have occurred.

sentences.target: 주관적 판단이 개입될 수 있으나, 객관적인 서술에서도 널리 쓰인다.
sentences.en: Although subjective judgment may be involved, it is also widely used in objective descriptions.

sentences.target: 기록이 삭제될락 말락 해서 즉시 백업을 진행했다.
sentences.en: The record was on the verge of being deleted, so an immediate backup was made.

sentences.target: 서류가 사라질락 말락 해 모두가 긴장했다.
sentences.en: The documents were about to disappear, making everyone tense.

sentences.target: 전원이 꺼질락 말락 해 장비 점검이 서둘러 진행되었다.
sentences.en: The power was about to shut off, so equipment checks were carried out quickly.

sentences.target: 차가 미끄러질락 말락 해 운전자가 급히 방향을 잡았다.
sentences.en: The car almost slipped, so the driver corrected the direction quickly.

sentences.target: 회의가 취소될락 말락 했지만 결국 예정대로 진행되었다.
sentences.en: The meeting was on the verge of being canceled but proceeded as scheduled.

sentences.target: 데이터가 손상될락 말락 해 긴급 복구가 필요했다.
sentences.en: The data was almost damaged, so an urgent recovery was necessary.

sentences.target: 연결이 끊어질락 말락 해서 통신팀이 즉각 조치를 취했다.
sentences.en: The connection was about to drop, so the communication team acted immediately.

sentences.target: 보고가 누락될락 말락 해 검토 과정이 강화되었다.
sentences.en: The report was close to being omitted, so the review process was strengthened.

sentences.target: 계약이 무산될락 말락 했으나 마지막 협상에서 합의가 이루어졌다.
sentences.en: The contract was on the verge of falling through, but an agreement was reached during the final negotiation.

sentences.target: 규모가 축소될락 말락 해 대안 마련이 시급했다.
sentences.en: The scale was about to be reduced, so preparing alternatives became urgent.

sentences.target: 예약이 취소될락 말락 해 대응팀이 빠르게 확인했다.
sentences.en: The reservation was almost canceled, so the response team checked it quickly.

sentences.target: 마감이 안 지켜질락 말락 해 작업이 밤까지 이어졌다.
sentences.en: The deadline was about to be missed, so the work continued late into the night.

sentences.target: 설계 오류가 드러날락 말락 해 전체 검토가 다시 이루어졌다.
sentences.en: A design flaw was on the verge of being revealed, so a full review was conducted again.

sentences.target: 안전 기준에 미달할락 말락 해 추가 점검이 요구되었다.
sentences.en: The project almost failed to meet safety standards, so additional inspections were required.

sentences.target: 성과가 뒤집힐락 말락 해 보고 절차가 더욱 엄격해졌다.
sentences.en: The outcome was close to being overturned, so the reporting procedure became more strict.

sentences.target: 투자 결정이 철회될락 말락 해 분석 보고서가 긴급히 제출되었다.
sentences.en: The investment decision was almost withdrawn, so an analysis report was submitted urgently.

sentences.target: 지표가 기준선을 벗어날락 말락 해 조정이 반복되었다.
sentences.en: The indicator was on the verge of falling below the baseline, so repeated adjustments were made.

sentences.target: 결과가 바뀔락 말락 해 관련 부서가 지속적으로 협의했다.
sentences.en: The result was nearly changed, so related departments continued their discussions.

sentences.target: 혼선이 생길락 말락 해 안내 체계가 강화되었다.
sentences.en: Confusion was close to occurring, so the guidance system was reinforced.

sentences.target: 문제가 재발할락 말락 해 대책 회의가 즉시 소집되었다.
sentences.en: The issue was about to recur, so an emergency meeting was convened immediately.
